capture.kind: isolated synthetic runtime; real HTTP and IPC implementations
capture.transport: CP admin HTTP -> real IPC bridge -> live inventory -> bounded synthetic runner; ephemeral migrated PGlite
capture.sanitization: All accounts, host names, servers, generations and runtime state are synthetic. No authorization headers or tokens are retained.
capture.limits: Not proven: deployed website/Edge authentication/TLS, live runner files, Podman, production or gameplay. The runner disk report is a declared synthetic reading, not a live filesystem capture.

validation.producer: npm test -- test/hosting-vps-live-read-isolation.test.ts test/hosting-vps-inventory-reads.test.ts; npm run test:hosting:api -- test/hosting-api/vps-inventory.test.ts
validation.contractCases: normal, 80% warning, over quota, zero/exhausted quota, unknown/failed report, invalid byte fields, older producer omitting storage, nullable quota, pending state, incompatible envelope
validation.rollingRollout: Existing consumers ignore additive storage; updated consumers render Unknown when an older producer omits it. No runner wire or IPC protocol version changes.
validation.finalHeads: Both exact final tested heads are pinned in both PR bodies; implementation heads and LF-normalized source digests above identify the captured code.
validation.sourceDigestEncoding: sha256 of UTF-8 source with CRLF normalized to LF
